title: Attacked in the mall world
content: I became lucid and awake in the mall world this morning. For some reason, I felt like if I could find this man that I know in my waking life, in the mall world too, we could have this awesome experience talking lucidly together in our dream. This is a romantic connection. I felt like he was there in mall world too I just needed to find him. So I started yelling out his name as I walked around. Then I started to ask people if they were awake. Some ignored me, a couple actually said no while looking vacant and asleep. One girl I saw walking near me was quietly crying as she walked. I asked her if she was awake and in between sobs she told me she’s just so sad and so scared. I felt like she was awake but I couldn’t console her though trying to. I told her it’ll be ok but then another woman rushed in to tend to her although I could tell they didn’t know each other I moved on walking down an escalator to a different area of this ginormous mall when I felt someone grab my arm. I turned around it was a weird looking short man (5 foot maybe less) with long arms and no neck and weird shaped faced. I could tell he was awake immediately but still asked him if he was. All the while he kept grabbing at me and I kept swatting him and trying to get out of his grasp. He replied like he was saying it to himself “it’s such a smooth festival. I hate killing people” he had a weird voice like what you expect a dwarf gnome or something to sound like. It then occurred to me he was trying to kill me not grope me! I began fighting back earnestly and he started to try and strangle me. His arms were unnaturally long and impossible to fight I realized I was going to lose the fight and willed myself back to body and woke myself up! I’m completely unnerved by this experience and wondered if anyone else has been attacked by an awake being the mall world? I really felt he was going to kill me
